name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Restore the last calendar renderer that reliably opened on hardware, and isolate date selection from all selection graphics. A 5wCal double tap now only stores the selected date and gives one 100 ms buzz; no blink, partial redraw, or full redraw occurs. The next single tap returns to Orbit using that selected date. Calendar entry no longer paints a navy transition first, and calendar startup errors show CAL ERR instead of leaving a blank purple screen.
